items.title: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
items.summary: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially a part of SpaceX.

items.title: How to tell if your AI platforms’ accounts have been hacked
items.summary: A guide on how to check if hackers have broken into your accounts on the most popular AI platforms.

items.title: Every fusion startup that has raised over $100M
items.summary: Fusion startups have raised $7.1 billion to date, with the majority of it going to a handful of companies.

items.title: Talks to sell PayPal to Stripe and Advent are heating up
items.summary: PayPal is still reportedly negotiating a potential sale to Stripe and private equity firm Advent, as the fintech firm's new CEO attempts to turn the company around.

items.title: Self-driving trucks are officially testing on California highways
items.summary: Aurora Innovation and Kodiak AI, two companies developing self-driving trucks, have received permits from the California Department of Motor Vehicles.

items.title: Thrive’s Joshua Kushner chides Silicon Valley VCs over AI euphoria
items.summary: The AI opportunity is huge, but "it would also be a grave error in our minds to let excitement weaken our investment discipline," Kushner warns in his first-ever investment letter.

items.title: What we know about the alleged Iranian hacks on US water utilities
items.summary: Over the last couple of weeks, hackers have targeted and broken into the systems of several water plants in the United States. Here’s what we know and don’t know about this wave of attacks allegedly carried out by the Iranian government.

items.title: Read-it-later app Pocket shut down — here are the best alternatives
items.summary: Pocket users have until October 8, 2025, to export their saved articles and other items, including lists, archives, favorites, notes, and highlights.

items.title: Unforgetful is a new reminders app for people who can’t stop hitting snooze
items.summary: Unforgetful, the latest app from longtime indie developer Marco Arment, is designed to make reminders harder to ignore — or accidentally dismiss.

items.title: Google will now allow users to remove visible watermark from its AI generations
items.summary: Turning off this setting won't affect invisible benchmarks used to identify an AI generated file.

items.title: Does Mark Zuckerberg really believe AI is ‘for everyone’?
items.summary: Meta released Glimmer this week, an open-weight AI model anyone can download and run on their own hardware — a contrast to Muse Spark, the company’s more powerful model that stays locked behind its own APIs. items.title: Apple proposes to take a 15% cut of purchases made outside the App Store
items.summary: Apple is asking a federal judge to allow it to charge commissions of up to 15% on purchases made through external links in iOS apps.

items.title: Kog is going deeper to squeeze more inference out of GPUs
items.summary: The idea that GPUs are poorly suited for agentic workflows may be a misconception, according to French startup Kog.

items.title: Hyperscalers might regret embracing natural gas if new forecast proves correct
items.summary: Natural gas prices could triple in some parts of the U.S., which could saddle hyperscalers with massive bills to power their AI data centers.

items.title: US courts will start publishing how often the government uses spyware
items.summary: The Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts told TechCrunch that it will start disclosing how many times judges authorized the use of spyware to wiretap suspected criminals.

items.title: Uber and Pony.ai plan to bring 2,000 robotaxis to Europe
items.summary: The partnership is expanding beyond the initial market of Zagreb, Croatia to four additional European cities.

items.title: Investors sue Selena Gomez alleging fraud tied to her mental health startup
items.summary: The plaintiffs say they invested nearly $1.2 million in the company, and are accusing Gomez of failing to build and market the startup.

items.title: Flock says its new tool will help identify police abuse, but hasn’t explained how it works
items.summary: The surveillance company announced it's making a tool called "Audit Assistance" mandatory for all customers, claiming it's already helped catch abuse. But the company has yet to explain how the tool works in detail, raising questions about its effectiveness.

items.title: If Apple sends you a push notification alerting you to a spyware attack, take it seriously
items.summary: Apple now sends out push notifications to iPhone lock screens when the company identifies government spyware targeting someone's devices.

items.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
items.summary: Built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2, Writer says the new system should provide deployment-ready capabilities at a much lower price.
